Under Length, Download MP4, SR, VTT, Meta and Poster are five identical outlined buttons the same height, so the one export a creator reaches for first has no more weight than the four sidecars.
Steps 4 through 7 below the failed step 3 keep the full row height, label color and divider as the completed steps, with no note that they are blocked, so the list still reads as a run in progress.
